title: rbac v2: enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging hardening
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Enforce KMS key region pinning for RBAC v2 resources and strengthen audit logging. Backwards-compatible rollout behind feature flag; migration script included.
description: Motivation: customers in regulated regions require that keys and encrypted data remain in a pinned region and that admin/role changes are fully auditable. This PR hardens RBAC v2 around KMS region residency and audit logging. It introduces validation at policy creation/enforcement time, stores KMS residency metadata on RBAC resources, and enriches audit events with key-region context. The work is intentionally conservative: feature gated under `rbac_v2_kms_hardening` and includes a reversible DB migration, extensive unit+integration tests, and rollout guidance. Changes include: 1) new KMS residency validation in the policy API and CLI; 2) RBAC enforcer now checks key-region constraints during access evaluation and rejects operations that would violate a resource's pinned region; 3) audit logger attaches kms_region and key_id hashes to every RBAC-related event, and logs decision rationale for policy denials; 4) DB migration adds ksm_residency and kms_key_id_hash columns to rbac_resources and a migration helper to backfill from existing attachments; 5) terraform/provider updates to surface region pinning attributes; 6) docs + migration guide and Linear/Jira links. Rollout plan: enable feature gate in a canary region, run migration in read-only mode to surface anomalies, then enable enforcement and monitor audit rate + denied events. If issues appear, the feature flag allows immediate fallback. Testing: unit tests (policy validation, enforcer), integration tests (mock KMS regions, cross-region deny), e2e upgrade test (migration + enforcement toggle). See CI summary for flaky tests fixed during review.

manual_verification_steps: 1) Run backfill in staging against largest tenant snapshot; 2) Enable feature gate in staging canary; 3) Create cross-region KMS key and attempt a policy assignment that pins to a different region - expect denial and detailed audit event; 4) Confirm terraform provider sets kms_region_pin and plan shows no drift; 5) Rollback by disabling feature flag if necessary.
security_considerations: This PR adds storage for kms_key_id_hash instead of raw key IDs to avoid key leakage. Audit events include key_id hashes and region names; audits are forwarded to the existing secure audit pipeline. No plaintext key material is stored. The backfill tool runs with service account that has read-only KMS metadata access. Added unit tests to ensure no secret fields are written to logs.
changelog_entry: Security: RBAC v2 - Enforce KMS region pinning and harden audit logging. Includes DB migration and provider changes. Feature gated.
support_ticket_refs: SUP-3472: customer reported cross-region key assignment bypass; this PR closes the root cause.
post_deploy_monitoring: Monitor metrics: rbac.kms_lookup_latency, rbac.kms_lookup_cache_hit_ratio, rbac.denied.count, rbac.audit.event_size. Alert if denied.count increases > 3x baseline for more than 5 minutes.
